title: The Burnt Deadline Revisited
author: Dominic Brightwater
blurb: Beatrix Reyes, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
